_comment_seg_method: instantseg is nextflow.config's default and the only backend that runs on a fresh clone -- it needs no trained model and its weights are Apache-2.0. To run StarDist instead, set seg_method to 'stardist' AND supply segmentation_model_dir (a path to a trained model directory) plus segmentation_model (its name); the StarDist knobs are seg_pmin, seg_pmax, seg_prob_thresh, seg_n_tiles_x and seg_n_tiles_y, and every one of them is silently discarded while seg_method is anything else.
_comment_resources: === Resource Limits === NOT SET ON PURPOSE (R4). max_cpus/max_memory have no default and are required by nextflow_schema.json; they are per-SITE, not per-run, so they belong in your own -c site.config (copied from conf/site.config.template), never in a -params-file. A -params-file value overrides -c, so a resource block here would silently defeat any site.config you layer on top of this preset.
